_about: Juice VFX table (juice track). Generated by game/scripts/fx/tools/juice_catalogue.py; edit that file, then re-run. Schema and event catalogue: Docs/JUICE.md. Sounds: res://assets/audio/juice_sfx.json (audio track); `sfx` here is a fallback.

player_footstep.doc: Each planted foot while walking or running (the animator's footstep signal). Small puff that grows with speed.

player_jump_1.doc: First jump of the chain leaves the ground.

player_jump_3.params: speed, node (Mak, for the attached spin trail)
player_jump_3.doc: Third (triple) jump: somersault. Ground shock ring, stars and a gold spin trail on Mak.

player_long_jump.doc: Long jump take-off: speed streaks trail behind.

player_side_flip.doc: Side somersault out of a skid.

player_wall_kick.params: normal (wall normal, required for the wall ring), node
player_wall_kick.doc: Kick off a wall. The ring lies flat on the wall and the puff sprays out of it.

player_land.doc: Touchdown. Tiers by impact: small dust crescents (3 to 7 m/s), dust and ring (7 to 12), heavy shock with pebbles (12+).

player_ham_slam_start.doc: Ham Slam hover twirl begins in the air.

player_ham_slam.doc: Ham Slam hits the ground (same moment as ground_pounded).

player_dive.doc: Dive starts (on the ground or in the air).

player_slide_start.params: node (required: the trail attaches to Mak)
player_slide_start.doc: Belly slide begins (after a dive lands, or a steep-slope slide). Starts a continuous dust trail.

player_slide_end.doc: Belly slide or slope slide ends (roll-out, stop, jump). Stops the trail.

player_hit.doc: Mak's attack landed on something (when the attack code knows; enemies also emit enemy_hurt). Gives the hitstop.

player_bounce.doc: Mak is launched by a bouncy surface or a stomp rebound (when no object event fires).

player_sniff.doc: Snout Sniff pulse (every ~0.7 s while held).

player_respawn.doc: Mak reappears at a checkpoint or spawn.

enemy_notice.doc: Enemy spots Mak (the '!' moment). Emit at the head position.

enemy_windup.doc: Attack telegraph starts (glint). Optional: enemies already flash orange.

enemy_attack.doc: The committed attack (charge, dive, slam) begins.

enemy_slam.doc: Ground-slam impact of an enemy (Gummy Brute bounce-slam).

enemy_hurt.doc: Enemy takes a hit but survives.

enemy_block.doc: Hit is blocked (Grenadier lance from the front). Clang sparks, no damage.

enemy_stunned.doc: Enemy is dizzy or winded (skid bonk, bee wall bonk). Starts orbiting stars on node.

enemy_recover.doc: Stun ends. Stops the dizzy stars.

enemy_defeat.doc: Enemy defeated: the per-family cartoon gag plus a hit spark and hitstop.

enemy_flee.doc: Defeated enemy leaves the stage (Woolly Wolf spins away in its underwear).

enemy_projectile_hit.doc: A projectile hits the ground or Mak.

boss_inhale.doc: Huff wind-up: air streams into his mouth (about 1.2 s).

boss_huff.doc: Each huff gust leaves his mouth.

boss_winded.doc: Panting window after the huffs: sweat drops and dizzy stars.

boss_charge_start.doc: Puff phase charge begins (paw scrape done).

boss_footstep.doc: Heavy footfall while charging or walking.

boss_chimney_smash.doc: Charge smashes a chimney or the parapet.

boss_swipe.doc: Paw swipe arc (emit at the wolf's feet; the arc is already boss-sized). Reserved: not emitted on night 01.

boss_tornado_end.doc: The hurricane tornado winds down and disappears.

boss_defeat.doc: Final hit: he balloons up and puffs away. Huge celebration pop.

object_acorn_spill.doc: Acorns pop out (crate, crow loot, enemy drop).

object_truffle_appear.doc: A mission truffle spawns (group cleared, cage opened, 100 acorns, pages complete).

object_truffle_collect.doc: Golden Truffle collected: burst, sunburst rays, confetti. Runs during the TRUFFLE GET pause.

object_pages_complete.doc: Fifth page: the set is complete.

object_portal_enter.doc: Mak jumps into a storybook (before the page turn).

object_door_unlock.doc: A locked door or book opens (Wolf's Door, book gate).

object_cloud_step.doc: Mak lands on a cloud platform.

object_platform_crumble.doc: A falling platform starts to drop.

object_bellows_blast.doc: A bellows machine pumps a gust.

object_bellows_break.doc: A bellows machine is Ham Slammed and breaks.

object_dig.doc: Buried treasure or sniff spot dug up.

object_mission_complete.doc: A mission's goal is met (before the truffle). Reserved: not emitted on night 01.

world_cocoa_burn.doc: Mak touches hot chocolate and is hurt (pair with player_hurt).

world_wind_gust.doc: A visible gust burst (bellows, snore, storm). Reserved: not emitted on night 01.

world_lightning.doc: Lightning strike flash (put it far away, toward the strike).

world_debris.doc: Generic rubble burst (falling ornaments, broken props). Reserved: not emitted on night 01.

player_brake.doc: Hard stop from a run (no reversal).

player_stomp.doc: Mak bounces off an enemy's head (pair with the enemy's own event).

player_sniff_found.doc: Snout Sniff locks onto a hidden truffle.

player_hat_change.doc: Hat swapped (pause menu): a magician's poof on Mak's head.

player_bonk.params: normal (wall normal), impact (m/s into the wall)
player_bonk.doc: Mak runs or dives face-first into a wall and bounces back (the bonk state). Stars and a dust slap on the wall.

object_crate_land.doc: A pushed or knocked crate lands after a drop.

player_sniff_air.doc: Idle animation beat: Mak sniffs the air (MakAnimator sniff_air). A tiny snout puff.

object_truffle_burst.doc: Truffle bursts out on collection (objects' own moment; the celebration is object_truffle_collect).

object_cage_lamp.doc: One of the cage's switch lamps lights.

object_hazard_touch.doc: Mak touches a damaging volume (not hot chocolate).

object_kill_zone.doc: Mak falls into a kill zone (no effect; the player emits player_fall_out).

object_platform_wobble.doc: A falling platform starts to wobble.

object_portal_page_turn.doc: A page flips on an open storybook (idle flourish).

player_wade_land.doc: Look polish 2026-10-19: landing in shallow water. Rings, a crown of droplets and foam at the waterline; replaces the land dust and thud.
